ExpressVPN: Premium VPN for Security, Privacy, and Blazing-Fast Streaming

Surf the web safely with just a few taps. ExpressVPN is a premium VPN service built for ultra-fast connections and private browsing on public Wi-Fi and other shared networks - across all your devices.

BLAZING-FAST SERVERS
Stream, game, and browse with lightning-fast speeds and unlimited bandwidth. Perfect for streaming your favorite TV shows and movies, sporting events, and more.

LARGE SERVER NETWORK
Access a global network with servers in 113 countries, including all 50 U.S. states, so you're covered wherever you go.

NO-LOGS POLICY (INDEPENDENTLY AUDITED)
Browse with enhanced privacy. Our strict no-logs policy has been independently audited to help ensure your IP address, location, and online activity stay private.

POWERFUL ONLINE SECURITY
Protect your data and online activity with advanced encryption that keeps your connection safe - even on public Wi-Fi hotspots and shared networks.

EXCLUSIVE VPN PROTOCOL
ExpressVPN's Lightway protocol was crafted from the ground up for enhanced speed, security, and reliability.

PRIVACY-FIRST TECHNOLOGY
ExpressVPN runs on RAM-only servers that never write data to a hard drive. All data is wiped on every reboot.

WIDE LANGUAGE SELECTION
Choose from 17 languages to make your app experience smooth and accessible, wherever you are in the world.

24/7 CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Get instant help whenever you need it. Reach out via live chat or email, and our experts will gladly answer any questions.

iOS APP FEATURES
• Auto-reconnects if your VPN connection drops
• Supports Lightway (UDP/TCP), OpenVPN (UDP/TCP), WireGuard, and IKEv2 encryption protocols
• Threat Manager: helps prevent apps from sharing your activity with trackers or malicious third parties

SUBSCRIPTION PLANS
Your ExpressVPN subscription includes access to apps across all major platforms, letting you secure all your devices. With support for up to 14 simultaneous connections, you can stay protected anytime, anywhere.

Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each billing period unless canceled at least 24 hours beforehand. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a
Subscription.
